column1: # Baseline: origin/main 3833c3938. The production built-ins have 319 primary names and six aliases (325 registry keys); 27 keys have ActorHandler and the 298 rows below have none.

# Source inventory: production init registrations in pkg/session (commands.go, map_cmds.go, cast_cmds.go, use_cmds.go), including aliases and dynamic do_not_here names. Go reads are direct handler reads unless marked as a helper/adapter.

# PR1 disposition totals: 81 command-level/switched-NPC gates and 30 NPC handler refusals are routed through the shared body context; 14 special fallbacks retain their order; 15 existing body helpers use the same context; 139 body-specific handlers and four shop-special fallbacks remain blocked under R4.

# PR2 routes 21 observation handlers (22 command names including the `?` alias) through the shared context. Help's wizonly gate uses body level; its known page-byte divergence remains blocked under R4. The review adds one dynamic social-action row to the 298-row PR1 baseline inventory. PR3 adds switched-body callbacks for put, wear, wield, hold, grab, and remove; other object rows remain blocked where the Go path is Player-bound or the mob lacks state required by C.

# Existing actor-lane registry keys (primary + shared aliases): ', :, auction, dismount, dream, emote, flee, follow, give, gossip, group, hit, kill, murder, report, rest, ride, roll, say, shout, sit, sleep, stand, tell, visible, wake, mount

# Existing lane spot-check C routes: do_move (directions), do_say/do_tell/do_echo, do_gen_comm, do_dream, do_hit/do_kill, do_flee, do_stand/do_sit/do_rest/do_sleep/do_wake, do_give, do_follow/do_group, do_report, do_ride/do_dismount, do_roll, do_visible. The underlying C call table is cited in each row below.
# Existing actor lanes, source mapped to C cmd_info and Go callback:
# hit/murder/kill -> do_hit/do_kill (src/interpreter.c:495, 525, 562), game.CharacterHit; C do_kill delegates NPCs to do_hit (src/act.offensive.c:138-141).

# give -> do_give (src/interpreter.c:463), NPCGiveCommand; follow -> do_follow (src/interpreter.c:450), CharacterFollow; group -> do_group (src/interpreter.c:471), World.GroupCommand; report -> do_report (src/interpreter.c:634), NPCReportCommand.

# ride -> do_ride (src/interpreter.c:659) and mount -> do_ride (src/interpreter.c:558), CharacterMount; dismount -> do_dismount (src/interpreter.c:416), CharacterDismount; roll -> do_roll (src/interpreter.c:664), CharacterRoll; visible -> do_visible (src/interpreter.c:802), CharacterVisible.

# C-first switched-body coverage in this checkout: switched-body-command-matrix-depth covers say/tell/emote/shout/gossip/auction/wake/follow/group/report/give/stand/sit/rest/sleep/ride/dismount; switched-actor-depth covers roll/visible; other switched scenarios cover north/south and follow/ride paths.

# Spot-check limit: east/west/up/down, dream, hit/murder/kill, flee, and the exact aliases '/:/mount have no dedicated switched C-first scenario in the checked-in corpus. Their C call bodies and Go actor handlers were source-checked here; proof phase must add coverage if rerouted or claimed.

# PR3 corrected proof: dp1521-2538-getweight-red @8a0bd5282 is NOT_CLEAN on the accumulated-weight case with the incorrect GetWeight check; dp1521-2538-totalweight-final @1f8e9fc3d is CLEAN (37/37), covering all 30 switch scenarios and seven ordinary samples.

# PR5 routes open/close/lock/unlock/pick, pour/fill, appraise/peek, and write through the shared body context; give keeps its existing actor-lane mapping above. The switched-body witness also exercises note writing: the mobile selects the note and pen while the descriptor owner handles editor input.

# PR5 census dp1521-pr5-object-class-final3 @c5132d66e is CLEAN (45/45, draw_divergent=0). It includes every switch scenario and ordinary samples for all rerouted commands, plus the mobile witness and command gates.
